apps.name: mLabeler
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform editor for singing voice labels: phonemes, notes, pitch and UTAU oto. Works with DiffSinger datasets, supports automatic labeling. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS

versions.localizedDescription:
• Web edition: browser-based editing on desktop and mobile, with built-in MCFL autolabelling, auto-oto, microphone recording and project ZIP import/export; no toolkit connection required. Normalized mouse-wheel scrolling and zoom sensitivity.

• Google Play: separate build with system folder access and built-in autolabelling; toolkit connections and GitHub updates are disabled.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: mLabeler connects to mVocalToolkit on your local network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: mLabeler records samples for voicebanks and datasets.
